aspects.says: The compiler knows a throw statement ends the block but checks a call to an always-throwing helper only against its signature, so the helper should return the exception for the caller to throw.
basis: section:The Compiler Knows a `throw` Ends the Block; It Doesn't Know Your Helper Always Throws

aspects.says: The translated exception keeps the lower layer's exception as its cause, so the log still shows what failed.
basis: section:Translate Exceptions at a Layer Boundary, and Keep the Cause

aspects.says: A lambda for a standard functional interface can't throw a checked exception, so it wraps it, and the enclosing method unwraps it before returning so callers catch the original checked type.
basis: section:A Checked Exception Can't Leave a `Function`: Wrap It in the Lambda, Unwrap It at Your Boundary

aspects.says: A wrapper thrown by a lazy stream escapes after the unwrapping try has ended, from the caller's terminal operation.
basis: section:A Checked Exception Can't Leave a `Function`: Wrap It in the Lambda, Unwrap It at Your Boundary

aspects.says: A sneaky throw compiles, but a caller's catch for the checked type is a compile error, and a dynamic proxy turns it into UndeclaredThrowableException.
basis: section:A Sneaky Throw Compiles, and Leaves Callers Unable to Name What It Throws

aspects.says: A method checks its arguments and preconditions before its first change of state, so a refused request leaves nothing half done.
basis: section:Throw Where the Bad Value Arrives, Before Anything Changes

aspects.says: The operand of throw is evaluated at run time, and a null operand throws NullPointerException.
basis: section:The Compiler Knows a `throw` Ends the Block; It Doesn't Know Your Helper Always Throws

aspects.says: The stack trace is recorded where the exception is constructed, so a factory method is the first frame and the throwing line the next.
basis: section:The Compiler Knows a `throw` Ends the Block; It Doesn't Know Your Helper Always Throws
aspects.reason: unit 3.1.1 grades where a trace is recorded; here it only explains the factory's frame, and a test on frame order would check the JVM rather than the reader's code

aspects.says: A service translates only the lower layer's own failure type, in a try holding only the call, so its own exceptions and bugs are not reported as store failures.
basis: section:Translate Exceptions at a Layer Boundary, and Keep the Cause

aspects.says: A bad value that nothing checks may not fail at all; a negative amount runs a transfer backwards.
basis: section:Throw Where the Bad Value Arrives, Before Anything Changes
